expect_history_contains: Remand targets Ponder -- countered, back to hand; draw a card
comment: REMAND aimed at our OWN spell through the play viewer's line path (2026-10-17, docs/design/remand-self-target.md). The passive opponent never casts, so Remand's only legal target is one of our own spells on the stack: the human declares the line the way it is played, `cast=Ponder;cast=Remand`, CheckLine matches the remand variant (Action::remand_by on Ponder's cast, both cards in its cast multiset), and the shared apply resolves it: three Islands pay {U} + {1}{U}, Ponder is countered back to hand without resolving, Remand draws a card. No other plan in the menu casts Remand -- it has no cast of its own.
